answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the mirror queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1865 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ridge. A 107 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
